set.body: Gap 5. BOLDZip archive payloads are decoder/carrier-format first, while real encoder variants remain missing. Acceptance: define the encoder spec and quality contract, add synthetic oracle/property tests for reconstruction error, sparsity, rank monotonicity, and residual events, then implement the first ScalaFIM-native encoder slice or leave a precise blocked note if the codec design needs a separate epic.
set.title: Latent: add BOLDZip encoder contract and implementation path
